description: Last real conclusion of every job in every push/pull_request workflow. The object list is discovered by parsing .github/workflows, not enumerated here, because the enforcement surface ledger only classifies scripts/qa/* and would never have looked at boundary-coverage, test, clippy, miri or cross-compile. Verified offline by scripts/qa/ci-liveness.rb in the ci.yml governance job; refreshed from `gh run` locally with --refresh --write.

knownFailing.reason: One gate failed in run 30385987450 and it is this ledger's own: liveness=failure, with all 33 other outcomes green including the two steps FR-145 added (pipefail-short-circuit and pipefail-short-circuit-fixtures, the latter reporting 18 passed, 0 failed on its first CI execution). This is DD-146's two-pass shape for the seventh FR running - FR-145 added two steps to ci.yml, which staled every record here at once, the liveness step reports that staleness, and the job it runs inside goes red for that alone; it cannot record its own recovery in one pass. The local certification sweep at 27f571f5 agrees exactly: 43 of 44 derived invocations green, the one non-zero being ci-liveness.rb. This refresh makes the record current at 27f571f5; the next run should show governance green and the refresh after it drops this annotation without anyone deciding to, as happened for FR-140 at cedbef41, FR-144 at 9e250e7f, FR-143 at 0c738312 and FR-133 at f105ce66.

workflows.reason: triggered by v* tags and workflow_dispatch only, so it has no last-run-on-main to assert. A release that fails is visible at the moment someone cuts it, and recording a stale tag build here would say less than nothing.
